generationInputs.prompt:
Create a visual storyboard for a synth-pop music video titled 'Mejor hazme robot' as a SINGLE IMAGE arranged in a 2x3 grid layout (2 columns, 3 rows). 

GRID LAYOUT INSTRUCTIONS:
- The image must be a single composite image divided into a 2x3 grid of 6 vertical panels (9:16 aspect ratio for each panel).
- Panels are numbered 1-6, left to right, top to bottom.
- Each panel should have a thin white border separating it from adjacent panels.
- Maintain the character from reference images (man with dark hair and goatee in a sleek white and green armored suit).

This storyboard has EXACTLY 6 frames:

Panel 1 (Intro/Verse 1): Tight Close-up of Jonas (the man from reference images) in a linen shirt, looking into a cracked mirror in a dimly lit room with warm amber lighting. He looks weary and is touching a wrinkle on his face.

Panel 2 (Chorus 1): Medium shot. Jonas is putting on the sleek white armor from the references. The green LEDs on the chest plate are starting to pulse with an emerald glow. 

Panel 3 (Verse 2): Jonas, now half-armored, reaches out to a record player that is glitching into green voxels and digital code. The background is a mix of a retro apartment and digital patterns.

Panel 4 (Bridge): Dramatic full-body shot. Jonas is now fully encased in the white and green armor from references, floating in a white void. Green data streams surround him. His visor is shut and glowing.

Panel 5 (Final Chorus): Dynamic tracking shot of the armored character in a vibrant digital dimension with neon green grids and euphoric lighting. He looks powerful and pristine.

Panel 6 (Outro): Medium shot. The armored character stands next to a low-res, flickering digital ghost of his older human self. The armor's visor displays a green pixelated smile emoticon. Dark background.

STYLE CONSISTENCY:
- Use the character and suit design from references (white plating, glowing green accents).
- Transition from warm, grainy film style (Panel 1) to a crisp, high-contrast digital electropop aesthetic (Panels 5-6).
- 9:16 overall aspect ratio.
